scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @self-notion/desktop verify && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.bugs: sh -c 'D="$HOME/Library/Application Support/app.selfnotion.desktop/bugs"; ls -t "$D" 2>/dev/null | head -10; L=$(ls -t "$D"/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "--- $L"; cat "$L" 2>/dev/null'
